content.text: Where is Token2049 Dubai taking place?

Token2049 Dubai is happening at the Madinat Jumeirah Conference Centre, one of Dubai's most prestigious venues. Expect stunning views, top-tier facilities, and a packed schedule of industry-leading talks and networking events!
What are the best hotels near the venue?

Great choices near Madinat Jumeirah include Jumeirah Al Naseem, Jumeirah Mina A'Salam, and Burj Al Arab for a luxury stay. More budget-friendly options include Al Qasr Hotel and Media One Hotel in Dubai Marina. Need more recommendations? Let me know your budget and preferences!
Where can I find the full side event schedule for TOKEN2049?
You can access the complete official side events list here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1y3D1zB9IIGJbLeF8aicSYoXxtiZ5kAS25Wj4a5hvovg/edit?gid=0#gid=0
